summary: Keeps array types whose component type is raw (instead of dropping them as raw) when computing tree types in JSpecify mode, and (via the stacked base) resolves unbound generic method-reference qualifiers from the functional-interface receiver.

tests.evidence: Behavior change in type computation; CodeRabbit (2026-09-07) noted no assignment/argument/return cases with a raw-array *target* (e.g. @Nullable Test<String>[] into Test[]), which the initial tests still lack; test issue1800 etc. cover only raw-array sources.

user_docs.evidence: JSpecify-mode checking behavior changes but NullAway documents such rules only in the wiki; no option or version change.

doc_comments.evidence: Public getTreeType/getMemberReferenceMethodType contracts changed (new parameter, raw-array exemption) and new public record ResolvedMethodReference; Javadoc updated, minor typo 'javac compute'.

change_description.evidence: Body explains why for the raw-array part, but the diff also carries the stacked method-reference changes (b2ae9c77..34c02819) that the description does not mention; git-spice stack explains it.

backward_compat.evidence: New diagnostics appear where NullAway was silent (raw array to parameterized array), but only in JSpecify mode, which is still evolving.

error_model.evidence: Newly reachable diagnostic reads 'incompatible types: @Nullable Test [] cannot be converted to Test<String> []' (JSpecifyArrayTests.rawArrayToParameterizedArray), which reads like a missing-type-argument error though only component nullability differs.

correctness.evidence: Non-trivial change across getTreeType callers; CodeRabbit flagged that raw-array targets still hit isRaw() shortcuts in GenericsChecks (assignment, return, parameter, override paths), so the policy is applied to sources only; not changed in final.

user_value.evidence: Fixes a reported false negative (#1800); clearly worthwhile.

surprising_behavior.evidence: Users see new errors on raw arrays (array writes, raw-to-parameterized conversions, generic inference failure) that previously passed silently.

contradictions.evidence: Comments on the bail-out in generateConstraintsForPseudoAssignment and isRaw() in inferConditionalExpressionType were already corrected in the submitted commits (db526577, 7d397c8d).

build_ci.evidence: Only a JDK-version guard inside a test; no build change.

spec_conformance.evidence: Interprets how JSpecify nullness applies to array types with raw components and to method-reference qualifier types.

plan.why: Type-system logic across many call sites needs its own pass separate from the user-facing diagnostics and contract docs.
